title: read response
description: Standard output of read in JSON mode: the workfile (READ-011), a node (READ-024), a property (READ-035), or a refusal. An answer has ok, message and severity alongside the node's or property's fields (READ-012); nested nodes don't. $defs/base is ReadResponse (overview 2.1).

base.description: ReadResponse: a Node or a ReadProperty, with the CommonResponse fields.

found.description: What an answer has alongside the node or property (READ-012): ok true, a message naming what was read, severity info.

overlay-property.description: A property of the workfile as written: no source.

overlay-node-fields.description: A node of the workfile as written (READ-051). Every node has origin internal.

overlay.description: read without a path (READ-011): the nodes of every __overlay__ body, under a root with no properties and no alias.

read-property-entry.description: A property of a merged node, with where its value is set.

read-node-fields.description: A merged node (READ-022, READ-052). origin is internal for a node the overlay adds or changes, external for one only the base has. A collapsed child has origin external and no properties or children.

read-node.description: A merged node nested in another.

read-node-answer.description: read <path> (READ-024): the merged node, with ok, message and severity.

read-property.description: One property of a merged node (READ-035), with the binding's type when it defines the property (READ-050), its description and the suggestions (READ-036).

noos-property-entry.description: Where the backend is noos: a property of a node. $compatible names the node's schema; an external node also has $symbol and $provides (READ-502). source when the property has a value (READ-501).

noos-source.description: Where the backend is noos: who set the value. user for a value the user set or cleared, bootstrap for one bootstrap filled in.

noos-node-fields.description: Where the backend is noos: a node (READ-501). origin is internal for a node the workfile stores, external for a board or driver resource it only names; alias is always empty.

noos-node-answer.description: Where the backend is noos: read <node>, with ok, message and severity.

noos-workfile.description: Where the backend is noos: read without a node (READ-500). The root is the workfile: its target (platform, and board when it has one) as properties, the stored nodes as children.

key.description: The workfile's file name without its extension: workfile for workfile.json.

value.description: null for a board when the workfile has none.

noos-property.description: Where the backend is noos: one property (READ-503), with its definition and what it can be set to. suggestions.values are the values update takes; can_create the schemas the user could add instead, [] when none.
